tramos_voz.texto: Viernes, nueve y cuarto... y el teléfono no para.
Mientras, en un sofá, alguien pide desde la app de su pizzería.
Y a Toni le llega así: escrito, por orden. Sin papelitos.

musica.prompt: Modern viral TikTok background track, 21 seconds, instrumental. Starts with tense playful suspense: muted plucked bass, ticking hi-hat and a quirky pizzicato motif that builds curiosity for 9 seconds, then a satisfying drop into a warm, bright, feel-good groove with funky clean guitar, claps and a light Italian mandolin flavour, confident and catchy, ends with a clean button ending at 20 seconds. Leaves space for a voiceover, no vocals.
